og.title: Telegram video size limit: 2 GB free, 4 GB Premium
og.description: The most generous chat app — and how to shrink a recording that still won't fit, in your browser.
hero.title: Telegram video size limit
hero.lead: Telegram takes videos up to 2 GB per file on a free account and 4 GB with Premium — unchanged since 2022 and more than any other mainstream chat app allows. There is no time limit; only the file size counts. A phone recording rarely gets near 2 GB, so the more common question is why a video looks worse after sending, which comes down to how you send it.
qa.h2: Telegram video limits at a glance
qa.r2.v: No time limit — only the file size counts.
qa.r3.v: Videos sent as media are recompressed by the app; sent as a file they arrive exactly as they are, up to the same 2 GB.
qa.after: In practice the 2 GB cap only matters for long screen recordings, exports from a camera, or a film. For everything else the choice that changes what the recipient sees is media versus file: media previews and plays inline but gets recompressed; a file arrives untouched but has to be downloaded.
tool.h2: Shrink a recording that's over the limit
tool.lead: Drop the video below and pick a target. Even 50 MB holds a minute of full-HD video at the original quality, and a long recording steps down gracefully instead of turning to mush. Compression runs on your own device — nothing is uploaded — and the result is checked so it never lands over the target.
fit.h2: How much video fits in 50 MB?
fit.lead: Length decides the picture size: the same 50 MB is spread across every second. These rows are what this compressor actually produces from a typical phone recording — full HD, 30 frames a second, with sound — at a 50 MB target.
fit.caption: What 50 MB gives you at different video lengths
fit.r1.q: Full HD at the original quality — nothing is lost
fit.r2.q: About half of full HD each way — clear on any phone
fit.r3.q: Reduced size — fine on a phone, soft on a laptop
fit.r4.q: Small picture; watchable, blocky on a big screen
fit.after: With Telegram's 2 GB ceiling you rarely need to go this small. Use a large target — or the 512 MB custom maximum — to bring a huge recording under the cap while keeping nearly all of the picture.
over.h2: Over 2 GB, or looks worse after sending?
over.p1: Over the cap: compress to a large target such as 512 MB — for a recording of ordinary length that keeps full HD and most of the detail — or cut it into parts with the trimmer. Looks worse: you sent it as media and Telegram recompressed it. Send it as a file instead (attach, then choose File rather than Gallery), or compress it yourself first so the app has nothing left to squeeze.
over.p2: Everything on this page runs locally in your browser — your video never leaves your device, and there is no account or watermark. Not sure a clip will fit at a decent quality? The bitrate calculator tells you the picture size a target supports for your video's exact length.
faq.q1: What is the maximum video size on Telegram?
faq.a1: 2 GB per file on a free account, 4 GB with Telegram Premium. The limit has been unchanged since 2022 and applies to any file, video or otherwise.
faq.q2: Is there a video length limit on Telegram?
faq.a2: No. Only the file size counts, so a long video is fine as long as the file is under 2 GB (or 4 GB with Premium).
faq.q3: Why does my video look worse after sending it on Telegram?
faq.a3: Because it was sent as media, which Telegram recompresses. Send the video as a file to keep it exactly as it is, or compress it yourself first so the app's own compression has little effect.
faq.q4: How do I send a video over 2 GB on Telegram?
faq.a4: Either compress it under 2 GB — a 512 MB target keeps full HD for recordings of ordinary length — or cut it into parts with the trimmer and send them in order. Premium raises the cap to 4 GB.
faq.q5: Is my video uploaded when I compress it here?
faq.a5: No. Compression runs in your browser on your own device — there is no server, no account and no watermark. The only place your video goes is where you post or send it yourself.
